operations.content: The repository is a Next.js App Router application using npm, configured for static export to out/.
The implementation is no longer in progress.
The initialization, implementation, validation, and repository push are complete.
Built and production-validated a responsive, accessible single-page ‘Hallo Welt’ website and pushed it to the public GitHub repository ozzyozbourne/hallo_welt.
Use npm run dev for local development and npm run build for the production static export.
A successful npm run build generates the deployable static site in out/.
